name: Huma
description: Permissionless DeFi yield, powered by real-world payment flows.

methodology.Fees: Yield credited on-chain to Huma 2.0 LP token balances (PST/mPST), measured from ModeAssetsRefreshedEvent deltas emitted by the refresh_pool_assets instruction. Each delta is new_assets minus old_assets after scheduled yield accrual (net of credit losses). Deposits and withdrawals do not emit this event.
methodology.Revenue: Zero — the permissionless pool has no protocol fee configured; all PayFi yield flows to LPs.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Same as Fees; all yield accrues to PST/mPST holders.

Fees.Assets Yields: Yield credited to PST/mPST LP balances.

SupplySideRevenue.Assets Yields: Same yield, accruing to PST/mPST holders.
